pretreatments.description: Steam pretreatment: Treatment of whiskey byproduct mixture (draff, thin stillage, and thick stillage) in an autoclave at 135 °C for 15 min, followed by cooling to room temperature, pH adjustment to 6.5–7.0 with 1 M NaOH, and storage at 4 °C for analysis. This method is applied to the untreated group to investigate the effect of low pH on steam heating.

Sulfuric acid pretreatment: Treatment of whiskey byproduct mixture using 2% v/v sulfuric acid at mild temperatures. Specifically, samples were pretreated with 4% H_2SO_4 at room temperature for 2 days (mentioned in introduction) or 2% H_2SO_4 at 135 °C for 15 min (mentioned in methods as the final concentration). The pretreatment was conducted in quadruplicate.
